Needs Improvement. Functions in a tablet fine. The demand for a review gets annoying when it repeatedly comes up in the middle of your question studies. During exam exercises you get questions from other states that actually say it’s for another state. You will get the same exact question multiple times in the same exam session. The grammar needs cleaned up in several questions. While no developer probably has access to any state test bank there is a level at which some of these questions are worded to throw you off and that’s not the intent of state testing exams. They want to know if you understand the content of a specific subject, not if you have the mental capacity to unwind their twisted question to make sense of it, then answer the question. Pictures sometimes come up blurry with no real purpose related to the questions. The app has a great format and layout. Needs a button within each question so you can report problems with the question. IMO - I don’t feel it’s worth paying for beyond the free trial.

Basic editing and sequencing issues. The language in some questions/answers is sometimes grammatically incorrect, sometimes to the point of obscuring the meaning. Tests often use the same questions repeatedly. As an example, many of the Basic Skills test (20 questions) used the same two (2) questions for more than half the test. Effectively reducing the value of study to a limited subset. Test/practice questions never vary the order of answers, which effectively (mis)trains you to respond with the position of the right answer rather than paying attention to content… needless to say, the “real” test doesn’t work that way. You could well find yourself conditioned to select a response based on its sequence rather than content.
